name: Texture Flow
algorithm: Texture Flow — 픽셀 수준 공간 분석
mechanism:
This method analyzes texture flow patterns in video for deepfake detection:

1. **텍스처Flow추정**: The motion field of texture elements (rather than edge features) is estimated using oriented texture correlation between frames. This captures how textured regions (skin, hair, fabric) move over time.

2. **텍스처-동작일관성**: Texture flow should be consistent with optical flow — texture moves with the surface it belongs to. The method compares texture flow with geometric optical flow (from edge features). Inconsistencies indicate texture that moves independently of the underlying geometry — a possible AI generation artifact.

3. **표면-텍스처일관성**: As surfaces rotate, textures foreshorten according to perspective. The method checks whether texture deformation is consistent with the estimated surface orientation change. Deepfake face generators may rotate faces without properly foreshortening skin texture.

4. **텍스처시간적안정성**: Fixed textures (skin pores, wrinkles, fabric pattern) should maintain their spatial relationship to surface geometry across frames. The method tracks texture-surface binding — texture that "slides" relative to the surface (like a projection rather than a surface property) indicates AI rendering.

5. **텍스처FlowBoundaries**: Texture flow should be continuous within objects and show discontinuities only at object boundaries (depth edges, occlusion boundaries). The method detects texture flow discontinuities within surfaces — internal flow breaks corresponding to face-swap boundaries reveal the extent of generated regions.
parameters:
분석 유형: 픽셀
미디어: 비디오
입력: Video frames extracted at key intervals
출력: 신뢰도 점수 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 중간~높음 — 70-88% 단독 정확도. Most effective when combined with other 비디오 forensic methods. Performance depends on 비디오 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 비디오 through 텍스트ure flow analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 비디오 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 비디오 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 비디오 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 비디오 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 비디오
